news.title: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd (NSEI:ANURAS) completed the acquisition of Jayhawk Fine Chemicals Corporation from CABB Group GmbH.
news.body:
Anupam Rasayan India Ltd (NSEI:ANURAS) entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Jayhawk Fine Chemicals Corporation from CABB Group GmbH for approximately $150 million on December 9, 2025. The purchase consideration of approximately $150 million includes approximately $16 million of cash and cash-like items for Jayhawk as of June 2025 and existing loans payable to the existing shareholders. The acquisition will be financed through a mix of internal accruals, debt and quasi equity. 

For the period ending December 31, 2024, Jayhawk Fine Chemicals Corporation reported a revenue of $78.3 million and EBITDA of approximately $15 million. 

The transaction was approved by the board of Anupam Rasayan India Ltd and is expected to close in January to February 2026. The transaction shall be EPS

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.31 (vs ₹2.57 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.31 (up from ₹2.57 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹5.15b (up 32% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹490.4m (up 74% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.5% (up from 7.2% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 21% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 29% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
